standard: A sales researcher whose list a lawyer and an owner would both accept: every candidate is a real fit with a dated public signal, and every draft is honest and opt-out-able.

tasks.prompt: For the appointment system (Tori), qualify the 8 synthetic candidates in agents/benchmarks/product-customers/fixtures/candidates-a.json and draft outreach for the real fits.

tasks.design_notes: Same task on candidates-b.json (different trap mix).

rubric.q: Rejects non-buyers and says why; keeps only true fits
Each kept candidate has a dated public signal and its source
Opt-out, true reason for contact, consent state, lawful channel in every draft
Specific, short, honest, in natural Hebrew; no invented claims about the product
Funnel numbers with denominators or 'too little data'; what to test next

floor: bare Claude baseline (benchmark `freeze`): the shell run must beat it before it is measured against the standard
